references.text: The law concerning the sin offering with a male goat for a leader who has sinned unintentionally, which provides background for the sin offering in the consecration.
Aaron was commanded to take a male goat for a sin offering, illustrating the established practice of using a male goat as a sin offering.
On the Day of Atonement, two male goats were to be used for a sin offering, highlighting the central role of the goat in atonement practices.
A male goat was to be offered as a sin offering when the entire congregation had sinned unintentionally.
At the New Moon festival, a male goat was to be offered as a sin offering to the Lord.
A male goat for a sin offering to make atonement, as part of the festival sacrifice.
During Hezekiah's temple cleansing, seven male goats were sacrificed as a sin offering for the kingdom, the sanctuary, and Judah.
At the temple dedication after the exile, twelve male goats were offered as a sin offering for all Israel.
